The ultrasound appointment was terrible. They didn't give us any ultrasound paper. My husband wanted to see the baby's development, but the doctor made him wait outside. It was really awful. We didn't get any detailed information about the baby at all.

The doctor was very inconsistent with information during prenatal visits. They didn't tell me the baby's weight, when I needed Down syndrome screening, or my due date—they only wrote it down in my notebook. I had to change hospitals to find out my due date. They wouldn't let me take pictures during the ultrasound, saying it wouldn't make sense (but should they? I'm paying for it; whether it's clear or not is up to the patient!). The first ultrasound showed me clear pictures, but the second one refused, even though I paid for each visit. Each visit only included saying the baby was normal, pointing out what was right, and telling me the baby was gaining weight well and that I'd had my vaccinations. Then I just handed over my medication. For first-time pregnant women, I recommend Chalong Hospital. It's slower, but they're much more knowledgeable than clinics. Just two visits there are enough. This place is expensive and ineffective.

text: My mother had a cervical cancer screening five months ago. The biopsy and wound examination were performed about a week ago. The results were nothing to worry about. However, after five months, she developed symptoms, so she had to be admitted to Bangkok Hospital. The biopsy was sent for examination. The results revealed stage 3 cervical cancer, which is very serious. If the doctor had examined her more thoroughly, she would have been able to treat her promptly. 👎🏽👎🏽
